f10_extent_mismatch.parquet.description: wavelength_max_nm 701 for an axis ending at 700 nm.

f10_infinite_stored.parquet.description: wavelength_max_nm is +inf: never equal to a finite extent.

f10_microns_not_converted.parquet.description: um axis with its extent stored in um instead of nm.

f10_wavenumber_not_converted.parquet.description: cm-1 axis with its extent stored in cm-1 instead of nm.

f11_bad_syntax.parquet.description: Licence expression ends with an operator.

f11_empty.parquet.description: Empty licence string: F2 (non_empty) only; F11 covers non-empty values.

f11_footer_licence.parquet.description: collection.license 'CC BY 4.0' is not an SPDX expression.

f11_lowercase_noassertion.parquet.description: `noassertion`: the SPDX special value is case-sensitive.

f11_lowercase_operator.parquet.description: Lower-case `or` is not an SPDX operator.

f11_undefined_ref.parquet.description: Row uses a LicenseRef not defined in collection.license_refs.

f12_spectra_included_float.parquet.description: spectra_included 99.0 (a JSON Schema integer) for 3 rows.

f12_spectra_included_mismatch.parquet.description: lab_a says spectra_included 5, but 3 rows use it.

f12_unknown_dataset.parquet.description: dataset_id 'lab_z' is not a footer datasets key.

f12_unused_dataset.parquet.description: datasets key lab_b has no rows.

f1_bad_created.parquet.description: `created` is not an RFC 3339 timestamp with a time zone.

f1_bad_dataset_key.parquet.description: datasets key 'lab a' does not match ^[A-Za-z0-9._~-]{1,200}$.

f1_corrupt_extension_page.parquet.description: A corrupt page in an extension column: every column is decoded (F1).

f1_corrupt_page.parquet.description: The `values` data page header is overwritten: F1 (not valid Parquet); the row-level rules are skipped.

f1_doi_trailing_newline.parquet.description: collection.doi ends with a newline: patterns match the whole value.

f1_empty_footer_licence.parquet.description: collection.license is empty: the footer schema (F1), not F11.

f1_f3_f7_unknowns_in_1_0.parquet.description: The same file declaring 1.0.0: the unknown member, extension, column and geometry are errors.

f1_f3_no_footer_unknown_column.parquet.description: No footer (F1); F3 still checks column names.

f1_footer_nan.parquet.description: A 1.1.0 footer with an unknown member whose value is NaN: NaN is not valid JSON, so the footer fails F1 even where unknown members are only warnings.

f1_format_version_leading_zero.parquet.description: format_version 1.01.0: semantic versions have no leading zeros (stricter than the footer schema pattern).

f1_impossible_created.parquet.description: `created` has the right shape but month 13.

f1_invalid_json.parquet.description: Footer value is not valid JSON.

f1_invalid_utf8_column_name.parquet.description: A column name is not UTF-8: the schema cannot be read, so F1 (not valid Parquet); every other rule is skipped.

f1_missing_footer.parquet.description: No `openspeclib` footer key (F3, F5, F6, F11, F12 are skipped).

f1_not_parquet.parquet.description: Not a Parquet file (attributed to F1; other rules skipped).

f1_unknown_footer_field.parquet.description: Footer has a property the schema does not allow.

f2_empty_name.parquet.description: `name` is an empty string on one row.

f2_invalid_utf8_name.parquet.description: `name` holds bytes that are not UTF-8 (F2 for a core column).

f2_null_value.parquet.description: Non-nullable core column `name` holds a null.

f2_wrong_type.parquet.description: original_id is int64 instead of string.

f3_future_minor_nested_column.parquet.description: format_version 1.1.0 with an unknown struct column: unknown columns are warnings, but every column must be flat (F3).

f3_index_column.parquet.description: Index-only column num_points in a collection file.

f3_invalid_utf8_x_column.parquet.description: An x_ string column holds bytes that are not UTF-8 (F3 for x_ columns).

f3_nested_x_column.parquet.description: x_meta is a struct: x_ columns must be flat.

f4_extension_type.parquet.description: sample_collection_date is string instead of date32.

f4_invalid_utf8_extra.parquet.description: `extra` holds bytes that are not UTF-8: one F4 finding, not two.

f5_wrong_prefix.parquet.description: Id prefix is not the footer collection.id.

f6_collection_mismatch.parquet.description: `collection` differs from the footer collection.id on one row.

f7_bad_quantity.parquet.description: quantity 'radiance' is not in the vocabulary.

f8_nan_wavelength.parquet.description: NaN in the axis (extent of the finite values is correct).

f8_not_monotonic.parquet.description: Axis goes up, down and up again (extent still correct).

f8_repeated_wavelength.parquet.description: Axis repeats a value: not strictly monotonic.

f8_zero_wavelength.parquet.description: Axis starts at 0 nm: wavelengths must be > 0.

f9_just_above_sentinel.parquet.description: A value of 1.0001e10 is a sentinel.

index_both_keys.parquet.description: Index footer plus an `openspeclib` key; checked with check_index.

index_duplicate_future_column.parquet.description: A 1.0.0 index over a 1.1.0 collection carrying its spectral_index column twice: a column may appear only once.

index_duplicate_id_across_files.parquet.description: conformance_minimal:a1 is in two listed files.

index_duplicate_row.parquet.description: One collection row appears twice in the index.

index_extension_value_for_lacking_file.p.description: material_formula is set on a valid_minimal row, but valid_minimal has no material_formula column (must be null).

index_extra_row.parquet.description: An index row has no matching collection row.

index_file_listed_twice.parquet.description: valid_minimal is listed as both `valid_minimal.parquet` and `./…`.

index_future_minor.parquet.description: An index declaring 1.1.0 with its own unknown column and footer member: warnings (section 11).

index_future_minor_nested_column.parquet.description: An index declaring 1.1.0 with an unknown struct column: every column must be flat.

index_list_mismatch.parquet.description: material_keywords (a list column) differs on one row.

index_metadata_mismatch.parquet.description: Footer metadata differs from the collection file's footer.

index_missing_extension_column.parquet.description: material_formula (present in valid_full) is not indexed.

index_missing_file.parquet.description: Footer lists a file that does not exist.

index_missing_row.parquet.description: A collection row is not in the index.

index_nested_x_column.parquet.description: An x_ struct column in the index: x_ columns must be flat.

index_null_typed_column.parquet.description: All-null dataset_id stored with the Arrow null type in the index.

index_num_spectra_mismatch.parquet.description: num_spectra differs from the file's row count.

index_of_nonconformant.parquet.description: I1 holds, but the indexed collection file fails F7, so the index does not conform.

index_over_future_minor.parquet.description: A 1.0.0 index listing a 1.1.0 collection: the embedded metadata is judged by its own format_version, so its unknown extension and member are warnings.

index_over_future_minor_with_column.parq.description: As index_over_future_minor, also carrying the collection's spectral_index column (unknown in 1.0.0): a warning, and its values are compared.

index_over_null_typed_collection.parquet.description: The collection stores dataset_id with the null type; the index as string.

index_sha256_mismatch.parquet.description: sha256 does not match the file.

index_shared_collection_id.parquet.description: Two listed files share the collection id conformance_minimal.

index_unknown_column.parquet.description: Index has a column `notes` that is neither required nor `x_`.

index_unknown_column_not_from_future_fil.description: A 1.0.0 index lists a 1.1.0 collection but has a column `notes` that no listed file holds: an error (the 1.1.0 file excuses only its own columns).

index_unlisted_file.parquet.description: One row points at elsewhere.parquet, which the footer does not list.

index_valid.parquet.description: Index over valid_minimal and valid_full: every non-array column, extension columns only valid_full has, `extra`, `x_custom`, num_points and file; sha256 for one entry.

index_value_mismatch.parquet.description: material_name differs from the collection file on one row.

index_wrong_type.parquet.description: num_points is int64 instead of int32.

index_x_column_differs.parquet.description: x_custom differs from the collection file: x_ columns are not compared.

r3_default_encoding.parquet.description: pyarrow defaults: dictionary encoding and snappy.

r3_dictionary.parquet.description: BYTE_STREAM_SPLIT and zstd, but one chunk records dictionary encoding.

r3_no_bss.parquet.description: zstd without dictionary, but no BYTE_STREAM_SPLIT.

valid_250_rows.parquet.description: One row group of exactly 250 spectra: no R2 warning.

valid_date64.parquet.description: sample_collection_date stored with the date64 hint: equals date32.

valid_descending_nm.parquet.description: A descending nm axis: min is the last element.

valid_dictionary_string.parquet.description: material_name stored as dictionary<int32, string>: still a string.

valid_empty.parquet.description: Zero rows: conformant, and exempt from R1.

valid_fixed_size_list.parquet.description: values and wavelengths stored as fixed_size_list[4]: still lists.

valid_full.parquet.description: Every extension column; aggregated collection with two datasets; NOASSERTION collection licence; LicenseRef row and dataset licences; compound SPDX expressions (AND/OR/WITH/+); descending cm-1 axis; NaN in values and stddev; `extra` and `x_custom` columns; wavelength_min_nm off by 2.5e-7 (within F10).

valid_future_minor.parquet.description: format_version 1.1.0 with a new geometry value, a new column, a new extension and a new footer member: unknown to a 1.0 checker, so warnings, not errors.

valid_large_types.parquet.description: large_string, string_view and large_list columns: equivalent to the plain types (spec section 4).

valid_minimal.parquet.description: Core columns only; nm and um axes; no extensions, no datasets.

valid_minimal_rest.parquet.description: The other two rows of valid_minimal (same collection id as the subset).

valid_minimal_subset.parquet.description: A deliberate subset (one row) of valid_minimal, with inclusion_notes.

valid_no_arrow_schema.parquet.description: valid_full written without an ARROW:schema entry, as non-Arrow writers do: types come from the Parquet logical types alone.

valid_null_dataset_id.parquet.description: All-null dataset_id stored with the Arrow null type.

valid_sentinel_limit.parquet.description: Values of exactly +-1e10 are allowed (the limit is > 1e10).
